name: Qwen3.8-27B (Unsloth NVFP4)
notes: Dense 27B, Unsloth's recommended all-round model for DGX Spark, and the recommended start for one Spark. Fits on one Spark; with two it is split across both. Same architecture as the verified Heretic card, so it runs on the same official vLLM image (0.29.1) without Ray; the quantization differs (compressed-tensors NVFP4 with FP8 activations and FP8 KV cache) and has not been run here yet.
